name: SitePageBody - Cookie Table On A Phone
description: The privacy page's cookie table in a CMS page body at phone width. Before the October responsive check it had no styles and ran off a small phone, scrolling the whole page sideways. Now the table keeps to the text column and scrolls inside its own box when it has to — here, in the isolation frame's wider fallback font, the last column reaches the edge; on the live site with its webfont all four columns fit at 390px.
